Human Resource Personnel Job at Goldseal College and Schools




        
    

        
        Goldseal College and Schools was founded in 2019. The school was born out of a quest for an educational institution of excellence by a couple, Sir Christian and Lady Nkem Anekwe, who, having seen their children enjoy quality education in Abuja, decided to bring to the eastern part of the country a school of the same standard and quality and make this accessible to children from this part of the country.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Human Resource Personnel

Job Location: Awka, Anambra
Job Type: Full-time

Requirements
     

            
    




	Interested applicant(s) should possess relevant qualifications and experience.


Interview Details


	Venue: Goldseal College and Schools, Behind Awka Wonderland, Mopol Base, Awka, Anambra State.
	Date: Saturday, 15th August, 2026.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their curriculum vitae and credentials to the Head of School via: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Customer service officer Job at Party Supplies and More




        
    

        
        Party Supplies and More is Nigeria's premier party supplies store, offering everything needed to make celebrations special. We provide high-quality decorations, balloons, and party essentials with exceptional customer service. Our values center on excellence, reliability, and innovation, ensuring every customer leaves happy and every event becomes unforgettable.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer service officer
Job Location: Lekki , Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We’re looking for a proactive Customer Care Representative with at least 1 year of recent experience.
	Must be social media-savvy, skilled in CRM tools, and live within or around Lekki due to the on-site nature of the role.


Key Responsibilities


	Respond to customer queries via phone, email, and chat
	Resolve issues quickly and professionally
	Log interactions using CRM system
	Follow up on unresolved cases
	Work with internal teams to improve service delivery
	Takes and fulfills customers orders


Requirements


	OND / HND / Bachelor’s degree
	1+ years recent customer service experience
	Proficiency with CRM tools
	Strong communication skills
	Lives in or near Lekki (mandatory)
	Creative, paysattention to details and a fast learner.


Salary
N100,000 - N150,000 per month. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using "Lekki CRM" as the subject of the mail.
